vo.text: Michel Lotito. They called him Monsieur Mangetout. Mister Eats-All.
Over two years, he's said to have eaten a whole Cessna one-fifty, piece by piece.
vo.cap: Over *2 years*: a whole *Cessna 150*, piece by piece.

vo.text: Also: eighteen bicycles, seven TVs, and a coffin. Nearly nine tons of metal.
vo.cap: *18 bikes.* *7 TVs.* A *coffin.* Nearly *9 tons* of metal.

vo.text: Guinness gave him a brass plaque for the strangest diet. He ate that too.
vo.cap: Guinness gave him a *brass plaque.* He *ate that too.*
